name: AeroStride Runner
description: Breathable, lightweight blue running shoe with a knit mesh upper and responsive foam midsole. Cushioned and stable, ideal for beginners easing into 5k training and cool in warm weather.

name: Trailblaze GTX
description: Waterproof trail-running shoe with an aggressive lugged outsole for grip on mud and rock. Protective toe cap and a secure midfoot for technical off-road terrain.

name: CloudStep Cushion
description: Max-cushion road running shoe built for long, comfortable miles. Plush high-density foam absorbs impact and reduces fatigue on marathon training runs.

name: SwiftRace Elite
description: Ultra-lightweight carbon-plated racing shoe engineered for speed and energy return. Snug, aerodynamic fit for competitive runners chasing personal bests.

name: UrbanWalk Classic
description: Clean, versatile leather sneaker for everyday wear. Cushioned footbed and durable rubber sole pair easily with jeans or shorts for all-day city comfort.

name: FlexMove Trainer
description: Stable cross-training shoe with a flat, grippy platform for lifting, HIIT and gym work. Reinforced sides support lateral movement during dynamic workouts.

name: TinyTrek Kids
description: Durable, breathable kids' running shoe with an easy hook-and-loop strap. Flexible sole supports active play and growing feet at school and the playground.

name: HydroGuard Waterproof
description: Fully waterproof walking shoe with sealed seams to keep feet dry in rain and puddles. Warm, comfortable, and grippy for wet-weather commutes.

name: BreezeKnit Slip-On
description: Ultra-breathable slip-on with a sock-like knit upper for effortless on-off wear. Light and airy, perfect for hot summer days and travel.

name: TrailGrip Hiker
description: Rugged waterproof hiking boot with ankle support and a deep-lug outsole. Built for rocky trails, heavy packs, and multi-day backcountry treks.

name: StudioFlow Yoga
description: Minimalist, flexible barefoot-style shoe for yoga, pilates and studio workouts. Lets feet move naturally with a grippy, low-profile sole.

name: MetroDash Commuter
description: Breathable commuter shoe with reflective accents for low-light safety. Cushioned yet sleek enough to transition from the train to the office.

name: ProCourt Tennis
description: Court tennis shoe with reinforced lateral support and a non-marking herringbone outsole for quick stops and direction changes on hard courts.

name: RecoverEase Slide
description: Plush recovery slide with deep, contoured cushioning to soothe tired feet after long runs or shifts on your feet. Easy slip-on comfort.

name: WinterWarm Boot
description: Insulated, waterproof winter boot with a fleece lining and heavy-tread sole for snow and ice. Keeps feet warm and sure-footed in the cold.

name: FeatherLite Racer
description: Featherweight blue racing trainer with a breathable open mesh and springy foam. A fast, cool ride for tempo runs and race day.

name: AllDay Comfort Walker
description: Wide-fit walking shoe with a memory-foam footbed and arch support for all-day comfort. Ideal for retail shifts, travel, and long strolls.

name: KidSport Active
description: Lightweight kids' sport shoe with a bright design, breathable mesh, and a bouncy sole for running, jumping, and everything in between.

name: Chocolate Recovery Shake
description: Plant-based high-protein recovery shake with 30g of pea-and-rice protein and only 4g of sugar. Dairy-free, vegan and smooth-textured, designed for post-workout muscle recovery and endurance training.

name: Vanilla Whey Protein Shake
description: Ready-to-drink vanilla whey protein shake with 25g of fast-absorbing dairy protein for muscle building and recovery. Creamy and smooth with a classic vanilla flavor.

name: Citrus Electrolyte Hydration
description: Light citrus electrolyte drink that replaces sodium and potassium lost in sweat. Low calorie and refreshing, ideal for hydration during long runs and hot-weather training.

name: Berry Plant Protein Smoothie
description: Organic mixed-berry smoothie with 20g of plant protein and real fruit. Dairy-free and vegan, a fruity, nutritious option for breakfast or post-workout refueling.

name: Citrus Energy Gel
description: Fast carbohydrate energy gel with a touch of caffeine for a mid-run boost. Easy to carry and quick to digest, built for endurance events and long training sessions.

name: Greek Yogurt Protein Drink
description: Drinkable Greek yogurt with 20g of protein and live probiotics for gut health. Thick, tangy and filling, a wholesome protein option for active lifestyles.
